_comment: Default dialog auto-responses that are safe in any project: pure warnings that Revit lets the user dismiss with OK without changing the model. Anything about deleting, overwriting, saving, syncing, detaching or auditing is deliberately NOT here — the AI must set an explicit rule via rcd_dialog_policy. Match fields: dialogId (TaskDialog id), messageRegex. overrideResult: IDOK=1, IDCANCEL=2, IDYES=6, IDNO=7, or { "commandLink": n }.
